Count Wrongula - Album 1: WHO

Wrong Turn

"One road closes, another appears"

[Rubato Intro]

Three days riding Polished black Wheels keep rolling No turning back

Forest waiting Road unspools Perfect weather Questionable rules

[Verse 1]

Carriage wheels on the old stone track Mountain fading slowly at our back Fredo steady with the reins in hand Like he could drive through fire and still look bland

Tisha’s reading three books at once Murmuring footnotes under her breath for fun Bella watches trees with a narrowed stare Watching me watching like she knows I don’t care

I say the journey’s perfectly tame Bella says confidence and foolishness often share a name Tisha keeps reading, Fredo keeps pace And I keep wearing calm across my face

[Pre-Chorus]

Three days there Three days home One dark carriage One stretch of road

Everything orderly Everything neat

Until the forest decides To interrupt my week

[Chorus]

Wrong turn Wrong turn The sign was subtle, I will admit A broken pass and a bridge in bits

Wrong turn Wrong turn Bella says fate has a twisted sense I say detours are not an offense

One road closes Another appears What could possibly happen here?

Wrong turn Wrong turn

And still we press ahead

[Verse 2]

Then in the middle of the afternoon The path runs dead beneath a shattered moon Bridge gone missing, the ravine laid bare Splintered boards and silence in the air

Fredo slows with elegant control Tisha looks up from an annotated scroll Bella steps down, scans the broken stone The kind of damage saying we should leave it alone

Nothing about this feels right Nothing about this feels planned Nothing about broken timber Says continue as intended

Bella says turn back while we still can Tisha agrees with a small raised hand Fredo says little, which is somehow worse When the quiet one frowns, I begin to feel cursed

[Pre-Chorus]

A side road waits Half lost in green The sort of path polite maps never mean Thin as a whisper Dark as a thought

Exactly the kind of road That says absolutely not

[Chorus]

Wrong turn Wrong turn Bridge out, warnings in the breeze Three against one and they all say please

Wrong turn Wrong turn Bella says nothing good lives that way I say nothing good ever comes from obeying decay

One road closes Another appears And my companions acquire opinions and fears

Wrong turn Wrong turn

I tell them all it’s fine

[Bridge]

Fredo turns the horses Tisha shuts her books Bella gives the side road One long unimpressed look

Branches bend together Like fingers overhead The air grows cooler The birdsong dead

Wheel by wheel The road grows strange Stone turns soft And shapes all change

Trees lean nearer Roots creep wide The forest seems to shift To see who’s come inside

[Theatrical Lift]

The light goes dim without the sun going down The leaves stop moving but still make a sound The horses stiffen The lantern swings

Something in the distance Listens without wings

Tisha finally closes the last of her texts Bella says this is exactly what she would expect Fredo keeps driving, calm as before Which somehow makes it all feel stranger than the forest floor

[Final Chorus]

Wrong turn Wrong turn The road less traveled now travels us Every mile humming dangerous

Wrong turn Wrong turn The trees stand closer than they should Like the whole world knows we’re in its wood

No map mentions A place like this No wind carries A hush like this

Something waking Something stern Watching closely

At our wrong turn

[Vamp Outro]

Bella rests one hand near her blade Tisha grips the satchel where her old notes stay Fredo guides the carriage through gathering shade And I look ahead like this was all my idea

The forest deepens The path grows thin The dark itself seems to breathe us in

And somewhere beyond the crooked fern

Something smiles

At our wrong turn
